result.title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
result.summary: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究自我改进智能体循环中的验证器问题，把验证器本身作为演化对象：由小型、多为确定性的缺陷检测器组合成可检查表达式，用锚定参考集的一致性与无标注输出共识来选择，并在 MBPP+、text-to-SQL 和无参考报告生成上检验其替代人工量规的可行性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「下游任务分数无法证明自我演化验证器有效」（空洞全通过验证器同样能训练出技能）的诊断，可能对 latent 推理轨迹训练中的监督信号选择、奖励黑客与贡献分配问题提供可核查线索；但不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，迁移需验证。
